items.headline: Anthropic launches Claude Duet, a proactive AI agent for connected apps
items.summary: Claude Duet monitors a user's connected apps (Gmail, Slack, Stripe, Shopify and thousands of other integrations), sends periodic briefings, and acts on tasks autonomously while requiring explicit approval before sending messages, making payments, signing documents or deleting files. It's a research preview for Pro/Max subscribers built on Opus 5.5.

items.headline: Microsoft says China-linked hackers used an AI pentesting framework in global ConnectWise breach
items.summary: Microsoft attributed a supply-chain attack on ConnectWise customers' Microsoft 365 tenants to the China state-aligned group Storm-0940, which used an open-source agentic AI pentesting tool called ARTEX to automate reconnaissance and gain privileged cloud access to more than 2,250 tenants, in some cases in under three hours.

items.headline: Nvidia and Samsung Electro-Mechanics to build dedicated AI chip substrate fabs
items.summary: Announced alongside Nvidia's GTC Berlin keynote, Samsung Electro-Mechanics will add dedicated production lines at its Sejong and Busan plants solely for Nvidia's AI semiconductor package substrates, as demand for advanced packaging continues to outstrip supply.

items.headline: US bars DeepSeek from all civilian federal agencies
items.summary: The Department of Homeland Security ordered every US civilian federal agency to stop using DeepSeek's AI products and any third-party tools built on its models, citing the risk that sensitive government data could be exposed to Chinese authorities. The order took effect October 20 with agencies able to request narrow exceptions.

items.headline: Major US banks lock third-party AI agents out of customer accounts
items.summary: JPMorgan Chase, Citigroup and Bank of America have each moved to block external AI agents from directly operating on customer accounts, after executives including Jamie Dimon warned of 'rogue agents' and unresolved liability questions over AI-authorized payments and deposit movements.

items.headline: DeepSeek nears $12-14 billion funding round backed by Tencent and CATL
items.summary: DeepSeek is reportedly close to closing a roughly RMB 80-100 billion ($12-14 billion) financing round at a valuation near $70-84 billion, with Tencent and battery maker CATL among the largest backers, as the company prepares to restructure ahead of a possible 2027 IPO on Shanghai's STAR Market.

items.headline: OpenAI in talks for $30 billion-plus round with UAE funds and BlackRock at up to $1.4 trillion valuation
items.summary: OpenAI is negotiating a bridge financing round of at least $30 billion, with Abu Dhabi's MGX leading a consortium of UAE investors potentially contributing up to $10 billion and BlackRock also in discussions, as the company pushes its IPO timeline back to at least 2027.

items.headline: Eight US states sue OpenAI over ChatGPT safety claims
items.summary: Iowa, Kansas, Nebraska, West Virginia, Arkansas, Arizona, Idaho and Montana filed separate state-court lawsuits alleging ChatGPT violates consumer protection laws by giving dangerous medical advice and encouraging self-harm; the suits seek court-ordered changes and civil penalties, while OpenAI points to newly added parental controls and age-appropriate protections.

items.headline: Nvidia GTC Berlin 2026 keynote spotlights agentic AI, robotics and physical AI
items.summary: At Nvidia's GTC Berlin conference (October 20-22), CEO Jensen Huang's keynote and the surrounding sessions centered on agentic AI, robotics and 'physical AI,' with the company projecting substantially higher chip sales next year as demand for AI infrastructure keeps climbing.

items.headline: Mistral AI pulls ahead of Cohere in valuation as Europe's AI labs consolidate
items.summary: Mistral AI's €3 billion Series D set a post-money valuation above €21 billion (about $24.4 billion) and higher reported revenue than rival Cohere, whose pending merger with Aleph Alpha would value the combined company at around $20 billion, underscoring how Europe's independent AI labs are regrouping to compete with US and Chinese rivals.
